subject: Channel integration / account ownership for AcmeRetail - Nimbus / CloudBridge
messages:
From: Scott Mayer <scott@nimbus.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, partners@cloudbridge.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Channel integration + account ownership question - AcmeRetail

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you’re well — quick one. We (Nimbus Consulting) are finalizing the technical integration with CloudBridge for AcmeRetail and they asked us to confirm which sales/partner motion owns commercial outreach for the account.

Historically Acme has worked with a CloudBridge solutions lead and an ISV (Nimbus) for professional services; CloudBridge’s channel team expects to continue owning renewals, but Acme’s procurement team wants a single point-of-contact for pre-sales and deployment coordination.

Before we put anything into our SOW (attached), can you confirm whether Redwood will assign the account to the CloudBridge-led partner motion or to Nimbus as the primary partner contact? There’s also a potential overlap with an internal commercial rep (I was told Marcus Lin has been working this account previously).

Attachments: Nimbus-Redwood-SOW-v1.pdf (pdf, 185KB)

Thanks — can we sync tomorrow for 20 minutes?

—Scott
Scott Mayer
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Consulting
scott@nimbus.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Scott Mayer <scott@nimbus.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, partners@cloudbridge.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Channel integration + account ownership question - AcmeRetail

Scott — thanks for the context and the SOW. I pulled together a short proposal (see attached matrix) for how we recommend handling ownership to avoid duplicate outreach and to preserve commercial routing:

- Recommendation: Assign commercial ownership to CloudBridge for renewals and contract negotiation; assign Nimbus (as ISV) primary technical/professional-services contact for deployment and pre-sales technical scoping. Redwood should designate a single partner ops lead as the escalation contact (our Partner Ops person would be Marcus Lin).
- Rationale: Keeps procurement conversations consolidated under the channel owner (CloudBridge) while letting Nimbus remain the trusted technical integrator. This aligns with Acme’s ask for a single point-of-contact while preserving partner economics.
- Action items: 1) Marcus to confirm no outstanding pipeline conflicts; 2) CloudBridge to accept the routing in writing; 3) Redwood CS to add the account record link + one-pager to Confluence.

I can be on a call tomorrow at 10:00am PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite with the proposed agenda (intro, ownership matrix, next steps).

Attachments: proposed-ownership-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

Brief points:
- Marcus, I pulled the pipeline history: Acme had inbound activity originating from CloudBridge in Q1; Marcus opened a champion relationship in Apr (see quoted history). No closed ARR yet.
- From a quota/comp perspective we prefer CloudBridge to retain commercial ownership for this engagement — prevents split crediting.
- Operational ask: can Partner Ops (Marcus) be the single escalation point in the portal so CloudBridge + Nimbus both have a clear place to surface issues?

On the call tomorrow I’ll highlight the pipeline impacts and comp/credit rationale.

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Decision needed on partner routing for AcmeRetail (time-sensitive)

Team — following the call this morning (notes attached to Confluence), we have one outstanding decision and a tight procurement window from Acme (they want a single point-of-contact in their vendor intake by Friday EOD PT).

Decision requested: Confirm canonical owner for sales/renewal outreach (two options):
1) CloudBridge as canonical commercial owner; Nimbus as technical/implementation partner; Redwood partner ops (Marcus) as escalation point.
2) Nimbus as primary partner ownership (commercial + technical).

Impact summary: If we pick option 1, CloudBridge keeps renewal economics and our compensation system will allocate credit to their partner team; operational setup is simpler for Acme procurement. If we pick option 2, Nimbus gets credit and will drive vendor-facing procurement conversations, but we must update billing and SLA ownership to show Nimbus as primary.

Requesting a decision + brief rationale by Thu 10:00am PT so we can communicate to Acme and finalize the SOW. If no decision, default routing will be option 1 to avoid procurement delays (per partner policy).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/78342

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
